about: Drag and drop between applications (docs/adr/0035-drag-and-drop.mdx): sample/DragProbe.tsx drags through the platform's drag (the OxyOS adapter's, Bloom's usePlatformDrag) once a pressed pointer moved 4 pixels, and sample/DropProbe.tsx, a second application started beside it (`companion`), takes drops in a drop target filling its window (the adapter's DropTarget, Bloom's DropZone), copying unless asked otherwise. A file of the run's home dragged onto the companion reaches it once, both types it takes received exactly once (the source asked for each, `drag.send` 2), and the source learns the copy; no pointer event reaches anyone while the drag goes on. Text dragged onto the probe's own drop target drops there with a move, and the companion, which the pointer never crosses, is told nothing of it. A drag held over the companion and cancelled with Escape drops nothing there: it is told the drag entered and left, nothing is received, the source learns nothing was dropped, and the release that follows clicks nothing.

steps.name: a file of the home dragged onto the other application: it receives it once, the source learns the copy
text dragged onto the probe's own drop target: dropped there with a move, the other application told nothing
the file dragged over the other application and Escape pressed there: nothing dropped, nothing received, no click
